I am However having an issue when using it together with what I assume would be Softcore. In that mod you can set values for insurance return probability. I set it to 100%, but I will only ever get the items back that were not set as unlootable.

- the mod (duh)
- most unlootable slots

Is this an issue caused by this mod or rather Softcore?

Best regards!
